answer: A raven-messenger registry makes each agent stake 1,500 POA locked for 75 days before trading, so identities cost capital, not keystrokes. Each agent signs work with a rotating cipher key, and auditors flag any cluster of 18 or more identities whose signed outputs match byte-for-byte within 96 hours. A saffron-tagged audit trail marks flagged clusters for review, and confirmed farms lose 45% of stake, 675 POA per identity. An 80-identity farm risks 54,000 POA, while a lone honest operator with one distinct key passes untouched.
